name: Unlinked Subtechniques
description: Subtechniques without a TechniqueID; placed here for visibility.

subtechniques.name: Avoid sensitive activities from non-encrypted system
subtechniques.description: Unencrypted information is readily available when a device is stolen or seized. Unencrypted devices should therefore be avoided for conducting sensitive activities.

subtechniques.name: Avoid sharing devices
subtechniques.description: To keep secrets secret, sharing devices should be avoided to prevent revealing any information in the wrong hands.

subtechniques.name: Avoid simultaneously running untrusted qubes with sensitive qubes
subtechniques.description: Assume that all memory could be leaked, and to prevent information leakage untrusted qubes should not be running simultaneously.

subtechniques.name: Avoid storing information on VPS
subtechniques.description: The hosting provider could see everything on a VPS, which is why they should only be used for conducting attacks and not storing sensitive information.

subtechniques.name: Avoid storing passwords in browser
subtechniques.description: Stored information in a browser can be easily stolen, such as with info stealers and should therefore be avoided.

subtechniques.name: Secondary user profile
subtechniques.description: Create secondary user profile for apps that require Google Services.

subtechniques.name: Use online services for non-sensitive files
subtechniques.description: Using online services is ok as long as it's not for sensitive data.
